subject: Capacity playbook: tying weekly pipeline to GPU reservations
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Linda Park <linda.park@acme.com>, Paul Benson <pb@cloudbroker.io>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity playbook: tying weekly pipeline to GPU reservations

Team — looping infra/finance and the Acme contact into a short weekly cadence to make GPU reservations predictable and tied to the sales pipeline. Goal: convert forecasted committed Q4 capacity into reservation commitments / temporary burst plans so we don’t miss SLAs or push customers to competitors.

Asks for this week:
- Marissa: attach per-deal forecasts for Acme & top-5 expansion opportunities (expected start dates + peak concurrent requests).
- Vivek / Dev: give hard limits for reserveable racks, preferred GPU types, and mitigation options for a 4–8 week ramp.
- Grace: confirm finance gating (when do we sign a reservation PO vs. use hosted credits).
- Linda: can you confirm Acme’s expected monthly peak vCPU/GPU hours and their preferred go-live week?

I attached the latest playbook draft and a blank template for per-deal sizing to keep inputs consistent. Let’s keep replies short; I’ll consolidate into action items and update the HubSpot deal. Weekly sync will be Fridays at 10:30 PT — first one next Friday unless objections.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Linda Park <linda.park@acme.com>
Cc: Paul Benson <pb@cloudbroker.io>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity playbook: tying weekly pipeline to GPU reservations

Karthik — attaching the Acme sizing workbook (acme_capacity_request.xlsx) and my consolidated Q4 pipeline (q4_pipeline_forecast.csv). Quick notes inline: 

- Acme (Deal RDW-DEAL-4387): expected pilot in week of 2026-11-09, production ramp to 200 concurrent sessions by 2027-01-15; estimated steady-state 120 T4-equivalent GPUs (see sheet "Acme sizing").
- Two expansion deals (DeltaApps, Boreal): combined ~60 GPUs peak between Dec–Feb; low confidence on exact dates.
- Request: prefer a short 8-week reservation with option to convert to annual commit if usage stabilizes.

Action: Marissa -> I’ll update the HubSpot deal stage and link the drive folder.

—Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Linda Park <linda.park@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-29T07:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity playbook: tying weekly pipeline to GPU reservations

Thanks for the template — uploaded a short Acme run-rate summary to the sheet. Key clarifications from our side: 
- Pilot week: 2026-11-09 is our earliest internal target; production go-live target 2027-01-15.
- Peak concurrency: 200 sessions (model: chat+code), roughly 1500 reqs/min at peak.
- Preferred GPU: lower-cost A10/T4 family is fine; we will accept burst to higher-end if needed for short windows.

We are comfortable with an 8-week trial reservation to start; procurement may want PO-level confirmation before Nov 1.

Linda Park
VP Product, Acme Corp
linda.park@acme.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Benson <pb@cloudbroker.io>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity playbook: tying weekly pipeline to GPU reservations

Appreciate the details — infra notes below: 

- Reserveable capacity: we can commit up to 160 T4/A10-equivalent GPUs in our east-us pool on a short-term reservation (4–12 weeks) without impacting existing Dedicated customers. Beyond that, we need to provision new racks (lead time 6–8 weeks).
- Burst plan: contract with CloudBroker (Paul) for on-demand bursts to A100-equivalent for short windows; slower cold starts apply.
- Mitigations: quantization guidance and model-splitting (offload embeddings to cheaper machines) can reduce GPU-equivalent need by ~20% in many prompt patterns — Dev/ML infra to test against Acme prompt set.

Please flag any hard constraints — otherwise I recommend an initial 8-week reservation for 120 GPUs (covering pilot->early-prod) and a committed addendum for +40 GPUs conditional on production activation metrics.

—Vivek
Head of Infra, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity playbook: tying weekly pipeline to GPU reservations

Adding a quick tech checklist for the Acme sizing validation: 
- Run their canonical prompt set against quantized q4 model variants (8-bit) — should save ~15–25% GPU cycles.
- Measure KV cache hit rates for chat sessions; if >70% we can reduce concurrency headroom.
- Provide a short test harness and synthetic load script by 2026-10-06.

I can lead the validation with Acme’s infra team (Linda), recommend a 2-week technical validation window prior to reservation finalization.

Dev Patel
Principal ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity playbook: tying weekly pipeline to GPU reservations

Confirmed — finance can approve an 8-week reservation pilot with the proposed size (120 GPUs) subject to: PO received by 2026-10-20, signed SOW with acceptance criteria, and a shared cost split if we need immediate rack provisioning. I will add a conditional budget hold for RDW-DEAL-4387.

I’ll join the weekly Fridays 10:30 PT cadence starting 2026-10-09.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
